description: Close Lean tasks with staged state and archive in one command.
delta: Lean git-workflow v14 replaces the manual DONE transition and archive pair with task close after committing the handoff. Explicit Resume skips execution start when the record is archived and state is DONE, commits staged closure records, and continues with worktree advance. The Lean bounded-worktree-lifecycle v7 repeats this exception at the start boundary. Both Lean skills carry the same closure and Resume steps. No Governed SDD gate changes.
upgradeNotes: Run meridian upgrade --apply to install the Lean closure and Resume rules in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md. Adapted closure or start text may conflict. No minimum framework or protocolVersion change.
verification: A pristine 1.2.15 Lean project upgrades to git-workflow v14 and bounded-worktree-lifecycle v7.
task close checks worktree, record, committed handoff, and Lean transition before writing state or archiving.
Archived DONE Resume returns started false and the next closure action.
